## AXRX 6800 16GBD6-M2DHC

### AMD Radeon™ RX 6800 Graphics

Introducing the AMD Radeon™ RX 6000 Series graphics cards, featuring the breakthrough AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture, engineered to deliver powerhouse performance for all gamers. The AMD Radeon™ RX 6800 Series graphics cards power a new generation of competitive and 4K gaming with vivid visuals, and elevated experiences in every game and every frame.

### Performance to Rule Your Game

For all the players. Every game. Every frame. Built on revolutionary AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture.

### Powerhouse Performance

AMD Radeon™ RX 6800 Series graphics cards deliver ultra-high frame rates and serious 4K gameplay. Get the ultimate gaming experience with powerful new compute units, groundbreaking AMD Infinity Cache, and up to 16GB of dedicated GDDR6 memory. And, when paired with an AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series desktop processor, AMD Smart Access Memory technology offers new levels of gaming performance.

### Vivid Visuals

AMD Radeon™ RX 6800 Series graphics cards pull you into the action with immersive gaming technologies and support for DirectX® 12 Ultimate. Experience gaming with realistic lighting, shadows, and reflections along with rich detail thanks to DirectX® Raytracing (DXR), variable rate shading (VRS), and AMD FidelityFX features, optimized for AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture.

### Elevated Experiences

Ultimate responsiveness and smooth gaming are up-leveled with low-latency gaming technology from AMD Radeon Anti-Lag and AMD Radeon Boost.1,2 Propel your gaming experience with the latest HDMI™ 2.1 VRR technology, USB-C™ enabled VR headsets, or over 1250 AMD FreeSync™ technology-enabled gaming displays.

...

Features

Radeon™ VR Ready Premium

Escape into lifelike realms of virtual reality experiences with Radeon VR Ready Premium solutions.

Radeon™ Chill

A power-saving feature that dynamically regulates frame rate based on your in-game movements. Radeon™ Chill can improve power efficiency and can lower temperatures for supported products and games when enabled through Radeon™ Software.

PCIe® 4.0 Support

The AMD Radeon™ RX 6000 Series graphics cards feature PCIe® 4.0, with a throughput of 16 GT/s which enables two times the bandwidth compared to PCIe® 3.0.

AMD RDNA™ 2 Architecture

AMD RDNA 2 architecture is the foundation of the upcoming revolution in PC gaming graphics, console, and cloud gaming, AMD RNDA 2 is a breakthrough architecture elevating and unifying visuals and gameplay across multi-gaming platforms in a way like no other graphics architecture before.

AMD FreeSync™ Technology

Take full advantage of the AMD Radeon™ RX 7000 Series graphics cards by pairing with a certified AMD FreeSync™ technology-enabled monitor to enable an exceptional stutter and tear-free gaming experience with high refresh rates, low latency, and stunning HDR.

## AXRX 6800 16GBD6-3DHR/OC

### 紅龍讓您釋放所有力量

PowerColor Red Dragon RX 6800 採用與Red Devil RX 6800 相同的新型扇葉設計，搭配2X 100mm和1X 90mm三風扇，以增強氣流和風壓，使卡片保持最佳冷卻狀態。此外，Red Dragon RX 6800 配備雙BIOS、設計感背板以及LED燈效。新一代Red Dragon RX 6800 帶您進入更高一層的遊戲體驗。

### 紅龍之力

PowerColor Red Dragon RX 6800 採用了全新的三風扇設計，310mm的散熱模組搭配7根6mm熱管，以及一個超大銅底座增加GPU和VRAM熱傳導及散熱，提供高效散熱解決方案。此外，它還配備了8+2相供電使用DrMOS、固態電容以及兩個8pin的電源連接器，以實現更好的性能表現。

### 強大性能

AMD Radeon™ RX 6800系列顯卡可提供超高幀率和出色的4K遊戲體驗。借助功能強大的新型計算單元，開創性的AMD Infinity高速緩存以及高達16GB的專用 GDDR6顯存，實現非凡地遊戲體驗。當與 AMD Ryzen™ 5000 系列桌上型處理器搭配使用時，AMD Smart Access Memory 技術可將遊戲性能提升到全新水平。

### 生動的視覺效果

AMD Radeon™ RX 6800系列顯卡借助沉浸式遊戲技術和DirectX® 12 Ultimate支持，讓您獲得身臨其境的遊戲體驗。歸功於DirectX® 光線跟蹤(DXR)、可變速率著色(VRS) 和針對AMD RDNA™ 2架構進行優化的AMD FidelityFX功能，您可以在逼真的照明、陰影和反射以及豐富的細節下體驗遊戲。

### 升級版體驗

借助 AMD Radeon™ Anti-Lag（抗延遲）和 AMD Radeon™ Boost的低延遲遊戲技術，進一步提升出色的響應能力和流暢的遊戲體驗。利用最新的HDMI™ 2.1 VRR 技術、支持 USB-C™ 的虛擬現實頭戴式設備或超過1250種採用AMD FreeSync™ 技術的遊戲顯示器，提升您的遊戲體驗。
